name: -6 AN 90 Degree Female Aluminum Hose End (PTFE)
title: -6 AN 90 Degree Female Aluminum Hose End (PTFE)
description:
The -6 AN 90 Degree Female Aluminum Hose End (PTFE) is engineered for high-demand automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings 90 Degree PTFE Female Aluminum Hose Ends are precision-engineered for high-pressure fuel, oil, coolant, brake, clutch, power steering, and E85 applications. Designed specifically for PTFE (Teflon-lined) braided hose, these PTFE fittings provide a secure, leak-free 37-degree flare seal for demanding street performance, racing, marine, and motorsport plumbing systems.

Each PTFE female hose end is CNC machined from aerospace-grade 6061-T6 billet aluminum and finished with ColorFittings’ proprietary polishing and anodizing process for superior corrosion resistance, strength, and long-term durability. Built to handle high temperature and high-pressure environments, these fittings are fully compatible with E85, ethanol, race fuel, pump gas, brake fluid, transmission fluid, oil, coolant, and hydraulic systems.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum with hard anodized protective finish.
• Flow Configuration: 90° mandrel-bent profile for maximum fluid velocity in tight engine bays.
• Compatibility: Engineered specifically for PTFE hose. Impervious to E85, race gas, methanol, and power steering fluid.
